html: Walking is one of the easiest ways to become more active. Begin with what feels comfortable, even ten minutes, and add a few minutes each week. Many adults work up to about two and a half hours of brisk activity spread across the week.

image.alt: Illustration of a walking path through a park
image.caption: A safe route and comfortable shoes are all you need to begin.
image.title: Illustration of a walking path through a park

html:
• Put walks on your calendar
  • Invite a friend, family member or dog along
  • Use a step counter or app to see your progress
  • Try new routes and a few hills as you get stronger

section.sectionHead: Check with your care team first if
html: You have a heart or lung condition, joint problems, or it's been a long time since you were active.
